topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was scrolling through the admissions blog, just passing time, when I saw it. There, in black and white, was my essay. The one I poured my heart into, convincing myself it was the key to my future. Now, it's on display, picked out for anyone to see. I didn’t sign up for this. I just wanted a chance, not to be a public example. What if it's not as good as I thought? What if everyone judges it? I need to find a way to talk to someone about this, but what do I even say?
